Warren Slams Trump’s AI Data Center Push
On Tuesday, in a post on
X
, Warren responded to Trump’s criticism of Americans opposing large AI data centers in their communities.
Warren wrote, "According to Donald Trump, if you don’t want a giant AI data center in your backyard, you’re ‘backwards and poor.’"
"You know what’s backwards?" Telling American families to shut up and pay higher electricity bills so trillion-dollar tech companies can build their AI empires,” she added.
